headline: Russell holds off Verstappen by 0.196s in Baku
standfirst: George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 0.196s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Isack Hadjar completing the podium after 51 laps of Baku.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: George Russell lined up first on the grid. Russell converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Hulkenberg, up 2 places to 16th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: Russell was never headed, leading all 51 laps. The race was neutralised by 2 safety car periods (lap 31–35, 36–38).

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Russell made 2 stops, running medium → soft tyres. The field made 36 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.3s for Russell on lap 31.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Kimi Antonelli made up the most ground, climbing 11 places from 16th to 5th. Piastri went the other way, slipping from 3rd to 13th. Timing recorded 160 on-track position changes, 16 of them by Hulkenberg.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Bottas (lap 50), Norris (lap 36), Gasly (lap 36), Alonso (lap 21), Stroll (lap 8), Albon (lap 30) and Colapinto (lap 37) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 40°C to 46°C, with air at 26–27°C. George Russell set the fastest lap, a 1:44.916 on lap 49.
